create_LlavaConfig: create an LlavaConfig instance with vision and text configs for a multimodal llava model
build_LlavaConfig_defaults: build an LlavaConfig with default vision and text configs when none are provided
initialize_LlavaConfig_from_dicts: initialize an LlavaConfig from dict-style vision and text configuration objects
configure_LlavaConfig_projector: configure an LlavaConfig with custom projector hidden act and vision feature layer settings
access_LlavaConfig_attribute_map: access the LlavaConfig attribute map that maps image_token_id to image_token_index
